notes.title: Patch 04/01/17
notes.notes:
Added a custom level loader. It detects missions in the custom/missions/ folder.
Fix unfloodable chest in level 'Feedback'. (Thanks to Max W Chase)
Fix difficult throws in levels 'Sinkhole', 'Clasp' and 'Escalate'. (Thanks to salty-horse and quad341)
Minor redesign of 'Clasp'.
Fix player spawn points in a few Oobleck Conundrum levels.
Redesign 'Altar' level to avoid a messy jump which players kept attempting.
Add support for multiple joysticks. (Thanks to Nezumi)
Remember to vote for Puzzle One on Steam Greenlight! It's difficult, addictive and it's going to be very cheap.

http://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=817410272

notes.title: Patch 04/12/16
notes.notes:
Fix unintuitive paradox caused by entering an enchanted jar whilst in an instance of the same type as the contents of the jar. (Thanks to Ouroboros)
Fix enchanted objects falling off edges during room transition. (Thanks to choongmyoung)


As before, this patch only affects Windows and Linux. The Mac version is not updated.

notes.title: Patch 04/10/16
notes.notes:
Only draw widescreen BG when necessary to limit Windows 10 rendering problems.
Game starts with a larger screen area.
Add button to cycle through perfect window sizes (Shift + F1).
Add more pitch range to jump sounds.
Prevent player leaving room directly after entering it, to prevent common issue where players would exit when trying to throwing item.

Thanks to notgreat for these suggestions.
